description: Standalone Figure 2 v2 reversal assay: a 600-s left conditioning pulse followed immediately by a 600-s right reversal pulse in the intact model at beta=0x, 1x, and 2x, with a 20,000-s post-reversal-start horizon.

metadata.conditioning_protocol: left outer-20% rectangular cue at 2*alpha0 from 0 through 600 s
metadata.reversal_protocol: right outer-40% rectangular cue at 4*alpha0 from 600 through 1200 s
